retrain: every round; fresh fit; no warm start
primary_selection: pooled development RMSE; deterministic id tie break
stage_A: H1, all 8 fixed model/feature pairs, expanding history
stage_B: best development A variant, expanding vs 730 forecast-day window vs expanding with 365-day exponential half-life sample weights
stage_C: H3/H6: mean baseline and best two distinct learned model families from development A; fixed chosen H1 history policy
report: all preselected variants rerun in 2025-26; online retraining may use earlier eligible report-season outcomes

fixed_parameters.two_part: CatBoost classifier and conditional played regressor, 200/depth5/lr.05; nonplaying conditional mean including negative cards

mean_baseline: per-player previous available rescored horizon labels, exponential 84-day half-life, shrinkage equivalent to 3 recent observations toward weighted training global mean
two_part_label: positive sum of observed native minutes over the full horizon; no outcome field in X
weights: 365-day half-life based on original forecast time; rescaled to mean 1 in training
training_rule: forecast_at and complete-horizon label available_at strictly before forecast origin; future labels never trained
selection_scope: no final season data influences stage selection
prices: last eligible match-row price snapshot; held until next eligible snapshot
universe: observed rows, not verified complete buyable roster
ranking: round Spearman; top10 sum and captain actual points across candidates with known horizon labels; exploratory, not a legal FPL squad simulation
missing_labels: excluded from evaluation, never filled; prediction generated for every observed candidate
confidence: paired round-block bootstrap 2000 repetitions; descriptive, overlapping horizons not independent
quality: all accepted estimates included; H1 sensitivity excludes flagged rows only in reporting
